categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Daye Garden Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of garden machinery products including lawn mowers, brush cutters/grass trimmers, and other power machinery and accessories. Its product portfolio covers gasoline-powered, lithium battery-powered, and AC-powered equipment, with various usage modes such as riding, walking, handheld, and intelligent robotic mowers. The company operates mainly in the garden machinery industry, focusing on specialized equipment for landscaping and lawn care.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies including lithium battery power systems, intelligent control, sensor integration, and robotic automation. It employs product, technology, and platform planning to accelerate innovation, with a strong focus on R&D in engine technology, transmission systems, battery management, and electric motors. Production follows a make-to-order model with some pre-production of complex components like mower chassis to ensure supply during peak seasons. Quality control and certification processes are rigorous, complying with international standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are international garden machinery brand manufacturers, large home improvement retailers, and specialized garden equipment wholesalers, mainly in mature markets such as the United States, Europe, and Oceania. Key clients include The Home Depot, Husqvarna Group, Kingfisher plc, Walmart, and other global brands. The company’s products are widely used in private gardens, public green spaces, golf courses, and professional turf maintenance.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ningbo Daye has a global footprint with sales in over 70 countries and regions, predominantly in North America, Europe, and Oceania. It operates multiple overseas subsidiaries and production bases in the United States, Mexico, Germany, Austria, Singapore, Thailand, and Hong Kong. The company’s international marketing and after-sales service networks are well established, supporting its global export-oriented business model.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the garden machinery supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles finished garden machinery products, sourcing key components such as engines, batteries, and electronic parts from qualified suppliers. It also manages procurement and supply chain logistics through its wholly-owned supply chain subsidiary, ensuring integration from component sourcing to final product delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global expansion through acquisitions (notably the 2025 acquisition of Germany’s AL-KO), enhancement of global manufacturing capabilities, and continuous innovation in intelligent and lithium battery-powered garden machinery. R&D focuses on smart robotic mowers, high-voltage lithium battery platforms (20V, 40V, 62V), and multifunctional, automated products. The company invests heavily in technology development, patent acquisition, and standard-setting to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of garden machinery products, with a strong emphasis on export sales (over 97% of revenue). The company employs a combination of ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and OBM (Original Brand Manufacturer) models, supplying international brands and also marketing its own brands such as MOWOX and GREEN MACHINE. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to large retailers and distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Daye is a leading domestic player and a top lawn mower manufacturer in China, recognized as a high-tech enterprise and a national green factory. It holds significant market share in the garden machinery sector and competes with global brands like Stihl, Husqvarna, Makita, and MTD. The acquisition of AL-KO enhances its competitive positioning in Europe and Oceania, expanding its brand portfolio and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.76 billion, representing an 89.67% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 16.1 million, a turnaround from a loss in the prior year. Total assets reached RMB 3.33 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.19 billion, up 7.51% and 45.95% respectively. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by increased production, sales volume, and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Daye emphasizes product innovation, quality, and compliance with international certifications to deliver reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly garden machinery. Its products feature advanced lithium battery technology, intelligent automation (including robotic mowers with AI and sensor fusion), and multifunctionality tailored to diverse customer needs. The company’s global manufacturing and R&D capabilities, combined with strong brand partnerships and localized service networks, provide differentiated value in competitive mature markets.
